advanced.skater_injuries: trained regularized player impact with replacement minutes and recovery scenarios

game_validation.scope: Conditional on retrospectively observed dressed player identities; projected minutes use only earlier games. Historical injury-report forecasting and playoff calibration are not established.
game_validation.upstream: 2025 game-strength and shot-quality inputs are retrospectively fitted. 2026 is later than all fitted skater, finishing and game-scale coefficients.

skater_impact.return_dates: Uniform scenario windows around reported estimates; uncertain defaults when no future estimate exists. Not a trained medical forecast.
limitations: Conditional on verified observed personnel and NHL shifts.
Source shot-quality model is retrospective; current-season evaluation uses only prior-season coefficients.
Historical injury-report timestamps are not reconstructed.
Individual effects are regularized estimates, not isolated causal guarantees.
Retrospectively rebuilt expected-goal values; not an untouched end-to-end holdout.
No independently validated skater injury-impact coefficient.
Game-win validation does not establish playoff-probability calibration.

advanced.summary: Recency-weighted goals and expected goals, five-on-five and special teams, projected/confirmed goalies, and schedule rest. Reported skater absences adjust projected replacement minutes using trained player effects. Return-date windows feed season simulations; historical injury-report and playoff calibration remain unestablished.

validation.summary: Retrospective 2025–26 evaluation: Brier 0.2451 versus 0.2507 for the previous Sweater model. Advanced historical xG can be retrospectively revised; forward validation is ongoing. Playoff calibration is not established.
